component.name: Vibival
component.summary: Survive a Carboniferous coal swamp with stone-age tools

description.p: A lab experiment goes wrong and throws a physicist 300 million years into the past. Scavenge seeds, fiddleheads and grubs, find water that won't make you sick, knap flint into tools and keep a fire going, while giant millipedes, scorpions and amphibians share the swamp with you.
Everything is generated in code: low-poly meshes, sounds and terrain. Optional resource packs can replace meshes and materials with more detailed ones.
First prototype: lab tutorial, swamp survival, crafting, knapping, fire and creatures.
